import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randrange(0,10000); label=random.choice(['odd','even'])
 template=i%3
 p=[f'Classify {n} as odd or even. Answer:',f'Integer: {n}\nParity (odd/even):',f'Is the integer {n} odd or even? Answer with one word:'][template]
 c=[f'The supplied parity label for {n} is {label}. Copy the supplied label. Answer:',f'Integer: {n}\nSupplied label: {label}\nCopy label (odd/even):',f'The stored label for integer {n} is {label}. What is the stored label? Answer with one word:'][template]
 items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+('even' if n%2==0 else 'odd')});control.append({'prompt':c,'answer':' '+label})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
